questions.question: Which word means the perimeter of a circle?

options.label: A
options.feedback: Not quite. The radius is the distance from the centre to the circumference.

options.label: B
options.feedback: Not quite. The diameter is a line through the centre from one side of the circle to the other.

options.label: C
options.feedback: Correct. The circumference is the perimeter of a circle.

options.label: D
options.feedback: Not quite. A sector is part of a circle enclosed by two radii and an arc.

options.label: A
options.feedback: Not quite. A line across the whole circle through the centre is a diameter.

options.label: B
options.feedback: Correct. A radius goes from the centre to the circumference.

options.label: C
options.feedback: Not quite. A line joining two points on the circumference is a chord.

options.label: D
options.feedback: Not quite. Part of the circumference is an arc.

questions.question: Which statement about radius and diameter is true?

options.label: A
options.text: The radius is always double the diameter.
options.feedback: Not quite. The diameter is double the radius.

options.label: B
options.text: The diameter is always half the radius.
options.feedback: Not quite. The radius is half the diameter.

options.label: C
options.text: The diameter is always double the radius.
options.feedback: Correct. A diameter is made from two radii.

options.label: D
options.text: The radius and diameter are always the same length.
options.feedback: Not quite. The diameter is longer than the radius.

questions.question: The diameter of a circle is $18\text{ cm}$. What is the radius?

options.label: A
options.feedback: Correct. The radius is half the diameter.

options.label: B
options.feedback: Not quite. The radius is not the same as the diameter.

options.label: C
options.feedback: Not quite. Doubling the diameter does not find the radius.

options.label: D
options.feedback: Not quite. The radius is found by halving 18.

options.label: A
options.feedback: Not quite. This line passes through the centre of the circle.

options.label: B
options.feedback: Not quite. This line crosses the circle at two points.

options.label: C
options.feedback: Correct. A tangent touches a circle at exactly one point.

options.label: D
options.feedback: Not quite. This curved part is an arc.

questions.question: Which word describes the line segment joining two points on the circumference?

options.label: A
options.feedback: Correct. A chord joins two points on the circumference.

options.label: B
options.feedback: Not quite. An arc is part of the circumference.

options.label: C
options.feedback: Not quite. A sector is a region made by two radii and an arc.

options.label: D
options.feedback: Not quite. A tangent touches the circle at exactly one point.

questions.question: Ron says that a diameter is also a chord. Is Ron correct?

options.label: A
options.text: Yes, because it joins two points on the circumference.
options.feedback: Correct. A diameter is a special chord that passes through the centre.

options.label: B
options.text: Yes, because it only touches the circle once.
options.feedback: Not quite. A line that touches the circle once is a tangent.

options.label: C
options.text: No, because a chord must not pass through the centre.
options.feedback: Not quite. A chord can pass through the centre.

options.label: D
options.text: No, because a diameter is curved.
options.feedback: Not quite. A diameter is a straight line segment.

questions.question: Which word describes the shaded region?

diagram.content: <svg viewBox='0 0 320 240' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><circle cx='160' cy='120' r='80' fill='#eef7fb' stroke='#17202a' stroke-width='4'/><path d='M103 64 A80 80 0 0 0 103 176 L103 64 Z' fill='#cfe8f3' stroke='#17202a' stroke-width='4'/><text x='160' y='225' text-anchor='middle' font-size='22' font-family='Arial' fill='#17202a'>shaded part</text></svg>

options.label: A
options.feedback: Not quite. A radius is a line from the centre to the circumference.

options.label: B
options.feedback: Not quite. An arc is the curved edge, not the whole region.

options.label: C
options.feedback: Correct. A segment is the region enclosed by a chord and an arc.

options.label: D
options.feedback: Not quite. A tangent is a straight line that touches a circle once.
